meaning: Defeat by consequence (#1007, pilot b). McTaggart's two theses entail that nothing changes: whatever changed would, by all change being A-series change, give an event changing in its A-series determinations, which his first thesis denies. Given F3 (something changes), at least one thesis is false. Uses no opining, motion or bridge premise, unlike MCTAGGART-UNREALITY-OF-TIME-REFUTED. McTaggart's later reply (Nature of Existence II, § 511: appearers do not change) denies exactly F3, so the defeat is relative to F3's floor marking.
